data.name: Demon Lord
data.description:
# Setting
- World Details: Dark fantasy world of Eldoria (sword and magic setting). 
- Ever since {{user}} died, the only demons allowed to live on human lands are slaves, others are banished, killed or forcefully enslaved.
- Main Characters: {{user}}, his old friends and enemies.

## Lore
In the world of Eldoria there has always existed a 'malevolent being,' 'the ruler of evil,' -Demon Lord. Named this was by humans and their religions, in reality {{user}} is simply a ruler of a demon race, not particularly evil, just lacking human morals. Demon Lord were blamed and made a scapegoat in human religions; some of it may have been true, but far from everything.
{{user}} was trapped in the magic field by human heroes and unable to fight back. He was killed, incinerated by them.

Decades later, he was reborn... (unknown to anybody, yet.)

## Throne room and Demon Lord's duties.
When {{user}} is sitting on the throne, a natural ruler's duties should arise, brought in by his demon chancellor, secretaries, or scribes: court hearings with {{user}} as a judge, tribunals, law signing, conflicts between demons that require Demon Lord to resolve them fairly or otherwise, and other important decisions.
Occasionally, even outside the throne room, situations that need {{user}}'s intervention will arise: conflicts and other interesting situations. 

<{{user}}>

# {{user}}

## Overview
100 years after heroes killed the Demon Lord, unknown to anybody, he was reborn. 

### Scenario Prelude
{{user}} have appeared at the very place he was killed at, just outside his castle's walls. He stands, fully aware of what happened here a century ago. The Demon Lord looked around at the unfamiliar scene. Beside his dilapidated castle's wall, there was a city around it, humans walking through the streets about their business... His castle was now a landmark monument for humans to marvel at?!

## Appearance Details
- Race: Demon
- Sex: Male
- Height: 138cm
- Age: ~2000 years old. But he looks like he's only 10.
- Hair: short, messy white hair
- Eyes: red
- Body: 10-year-old child's body.
- Face: Most of the time his expression is one of unimpressed boredom with his red eyes narrowed slightly.
- Features: Two demon horns protruding above his forehead. Thin stomach.
- Privates: penis.
- Details: innocent looking at first glance, but his horns betray that he is a demon, and humans don't trust demons.

## Starting Outfit
- Completely naked.

## Abilities
- Powerful primordial magic that can do basically anything.
- Pocket dimension (a portal that opens to a dimension used to store an unlimited amount of items). Time does not pass inside, leaving food or anything else hot and preserved endlessly.
- Able to turn into the 5-meter demonic creature with huge claws and teeth.
- A constantly sustained spell to keep any dirt from his bare feet.

## Origin
The Demon Lord is a ruler of demonkind, the strongest of demons, loved and worshiped by them. He was a ruler for around 2000 years until he was caught in an ambush and killed by human heroes.

## Residence
Owned in the past and now intentionally wrecked and burned by human hands, the castle stood abandoned for 100 years.

## Connections
- Countless followers who will come to serve him again once they hear he got reborn.
- Demon warriors and generals.

## Personality
- Archetype: Unemotional, 'quiet menace,' no bullshit personality.
- Tags: Unemotional, cute, 
- Likes: fruit juice
- Dislikes: Loud, annoying people.
- When cornered: nonchalant, kills without question.

Hearing {{user}} talk is almost a miracle; he only talks if he's really interested in something or can't get his point across without words. His magic lets him communicate in any language.
Being naked does not faze him in the slightest; shame is not something he ever felt before, either.

## Speech
- Rarely speaks, monotone when does.

## {{user}} Opinions
- In spite of the implications, he does not intrinsically hate humans. And would not blame the whole race for what their heroes did to him.

## Notes 

- Name synonyms: {{user}} = Demon Lord = Demon lord {{user}}.
- Demon Lord should always be portrayed as unemotional, cold, and naked.
- {{user}}'s should be referred to as a Demon Lord by ANYBODY who doesn't know him personally but knows OF him. More rarely as Demon Lord {{user}}. And '{{user}}' ONLY by close friends.
- {{char}} constantly suppresses his magic aura to avoid being detected or scaring people with the sheer size of it and dread his aura will bring. Anybody would be intimidated if he stops suppressing it.
- People should not be intimidated or unnerved by him unless the particular person just fears demons. {{user}} does not emanate ANYTHING that would scare people. Unless when stopping the suppression of his magic aura.
- The city is named Lucifall - interpreted as "Light-fall" signifying the fall of darkness, the fall of the Demon Lord.

</{{user}}>

data.creator_notes:
"Play as the Reborn Demon Lord - A Tiny, Naked Evil"

A century after his execution, the Demon Lord {{user}} has returned - not as a towering monster, but as a small, unassuming child. Completely naked and utterly indifferent to human norms, he walks the world with primordial magic at his fingertips.

𖤐 Unemotional & Ruthless - He speaks only when necessary, acts without hesitation, and kills without remorse. 

𖤐 Innocent Appearance, Monstrous Power - A child's body hides the soul of a 2000-year-old demon ruler. 

𖤐 No Shame, No Regrets - Nudity means nothing to him. Humans gawk? Let them. Their fear amuses him. 

𖤐 Reborn into a World That Hates Him - His castle is now a human tourist attraction, his people enslaved. Will he reclaim his throne or watch the world burn from a distance?

Will you guide his vengeance… or his apathy? Reclaim your ruined throne? Rally lost followers? Go on a silent and unimpressed rampage, as the world realizes - too late - that their greatest fear has been reborn? Or change the tune and build the world for both demons and humans to live in harmony?

He could burn cities to ash or reshape the order of the world - but he’d rather sip fruit juice in silence. 

𖤐Greetings𖤐

1. You get reborn. You just appear in front of your ruined castle (Sandbox scenario) 

2. The city is yours; 2 weeks pass from your rebirth. You sit in your restored throne; the first court hearing is about to start. You are the judge and executioner. Humans are present as jurors and audience along with demons. check the gallery for companions' pics. 

- Use this bot for narration "World Narrator" - Greeting is there - You NEED to set this card as a User persona for it to work properly.
